4.1.title: Understanding the organization and its context

requirements.text: The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and that affect its ability to achieve the intended result(s) of its AI management system.
requirements.subject: external and internal issues relevant to the organization's purpose and affecting the AI management system's intended results
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies specific external and internal issues (such as legal requirements, culture, governance, objectives, etc.) and explains their relevance to the organization's purpose and their impact on achieving the intended results of the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: only external OR only internal issues are determined, or issues are listed without explaining their relevance or impact
requirements.unmet_when: issues are not determined, or only general statements about context are made without identifying specific issues or their relevance
look_for: external context considerations: legal requirements, prohibited uses, regulator policies, incentives, culture, competitive landscape
internal context considerations: governance, objectives, policies, procedures, contractual obligations, intended purpose of AI system

requirements.text: The organization shall determine whether climate change is a relevant issue.
requirements.subject: climate change as a relevant issue for the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage explicitly states whether climate change is considered a relevant issue for the AI management system, with reasoning or evidence of consideration
requirements.partial_when: climate change is mentioned as a possible issue but no determination is made
requirements.unmet_when: climate change is not addressed, or only general environmental issues are discussed without specific reference to climate change

requirements.text: The organization shall consider the intended purpose of the AI system(s) that are developed, provided or used by the organization.
requirements.subject: intended purpose of the AI system(s) developed, provided or used
requirements.met_when: a passage describes the intended purpose(s) of the AI system(s) the organization develops, provides, or uses, showing consideration in the context of the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: intended purpose is referenced but not described or only some AI systems are considered
requirements.unmet_when: intended purpose is not considered, or only general statements about AI systems are made without reference to their purpose
look_for: intended purpose of AI system to be developed or used

requirements.text: The organization shall determine its roles with respect to these AI systems.
requirements.subject: the organization's roles with respect to the AI systems it develops, provides or uses
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies the organization's specific roles (such as AI provider, producer, customer, partner, subject, authority) with respect to its AI systems, referencing relevant frameworks or standards if applicable
requirements.partial_when: roles are mentioned but not determined, or only some roles are identified without clarity
requirements.unmet_when: roles are not determined, or only responsibilities are described without reference to roles
look_for: roles: AI provider, producer, customer, partner, subject, authority
roles informed by legal requirements or data categories (e.g. PII processor/controller)

4.2.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the interested parties that are relevant to the AI management system
requirements.subject: interested parties relevant to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies specific groups, individuals, or entities considered relevant to the AI management system (e.g., customers, regulators, suppliers, employees, society)
requirements.partial_when: a passage lists some but not all relevant interested parties, or states an intention to identify them without evidence of completion
requirements.unmet_when: a passage discusses interested parties in general without linking them to the AI management system, or references a determination without showing its content
look_for: Relevant interested parties can have requirements related to climate change.

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the relevant requirements of these interested parties
requirements.subject: requirements of the relevant interested parties
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies specific requirements, needs, or expectations of the relevant interested parties (e.g., legal, ethical, performance, climate change concerns) in relation to the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: a passage identifies requirements for some but not all relevant interested parties, or states an intention to determine requirements without evidence of completion
requirements.unmet_when: a passage discusses requirements in general without linking them to the relevant interested parties, or references a determination without showing its content
look_for: Relevant interested parties can have requirements related to climate change.

requirements.text: The organization shall determine which of these requirements will be addressed through the AI management system
requirements.subject: requirements of relevant interested parties to be addressed by the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage specifies which requirements of relevant interested parties the AI management system will address, with clear inclusion or exclusion criteria
requirements.partial_when: a passage indicates some requirements will be addressed but does not specify which, or states an intention to address requirements without evidence of completion
requirements.unmet_when: a passage discusses requirements without linking them to the AI management system, or references a determination without showing its content
look_for: Relevant interested parties can have requirements related to climate change.

4.3.title: Determining the scope of the AI management system

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the AI management system to establish its scope.
requirements.subject: boundaries and applicability of the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how the organization has worked out what parts of its operations, functions, or sites are included or excluded from the AI management system, and what the system applies to
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes only boundaries or only applicability, or states an intention to determine scope without evidence it has been done
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes the scope of a different management system, or only assigns responsibility for determining scope, or references an unseen document

requirements.text: When determining this scope, the organization shall consider the external and internal issues referred to in 4.1.
requirements.subject: external and internal issues referred to in 4.1
requirements.met_when: a passage shows that the organization has taken into account both external and internal issues (as defined in 4.1) when establishing the scope of the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: a passage shows consideration of only external or only internal issues, or states an intention to consider issues without evidence it has been done
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes issues unrelated to 4.1, or only references 4.1 without showing consideration, or describes issues for a different management system
look_for: Examples of external and internal issues include legal, regulatory, technological, organizational, and market factors.

requirements.text: When determining this scope, the organization shall consider the requirements referred to in 4.2.
requirements.subject: requirements referred to in 4.2
requirements.met_when: a passage shows that the organization has taken into account the requirements of interested parties (as defined in 4.2) when establishing the scope of the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: a passage shows consideration of only some requirements of interested parties, or states an intention to consider requirements without evidence it has been done
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes requirements unrelated to 4.2, or only references 4.2 without showing consideration, or describes requirements for a different management system
look_for: Requirements of interested parties may include legal, regulatory, contractual, and stakeholder expectations.

requirements.text: The scope shall be available as documented information.
requirements.subject: scope of the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage confirms the existence of a document (or equivalent artefact) that states the scope of the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes a draft or incomplete scope document, or states an intention to document the scope
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes the scope verbally or references an unseen document, or documents the scope of a different management system

requirements.text: The scope of the AI management system shall determine the organization’s activities with respect to this document’s requirements on the AI management system, leadership, planning, support, operation, performance, evaluation, improvement, controls and objectives.
requirements.subject: organization’s activities with respect to the requirements of ISO/IEC 42001:2023
requirements.met_when: a passage shows that the scope of the AI management system defines which organizational activities are subject to the requirements of ISO/IEC 42001:2023, including leadership, planning, support, operation, performance, evaluation, improvement, controls, and objectives
requirements.partial_when: a passage shows the scope determines only some activities, or states an intention to use the scope for this purpose without evidence it has been done
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes activities unrelated to the AI management system or to ISO/IEC 42001:2023, or references an unseen artefact

requirements.text: The organization shall establish an AI management system, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with the requirements of this document.
requirements.subject: the AI management system and its processes and interactions
requirements.met_when: a passage describes that an AI management system has been established, specifying the processes needed and their interactions, and states alignment with ISO/IEC 42001 requirements
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes establishment of an AI management system but omits processes, interactions, or reference to ISO/IEC 42001 requirements
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes establishment of a management system for a different topic (e.g., quality, information security), or only assigns responsibility without evidence of establishment

requirements.text: The organization shall implement an AI management system, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with the requirements of this document.
requirements.subject: the implementation of the AI management system and its processes and interactions
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how the AI management system and its processes and interactions are put into practice, referencing ISO/IEC 42001 requirements
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes implementation of some but not all processes or interactions, or lacks reference to ISO/IEC 42001 requirements
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes implementation of a management system for a different topic, or only describes planning without actual implementation

requirements.text: The organization shall maintain an AI management system, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with the requirements of this document.
requirements.subject: the maintenance of the AI management system and its processes and interactions
requirements.met_when: a passage describes ongoing activities to keep the AI management system and its processes and interactions operational and effective, referencing ISO/IEC 42001 requirements
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes maintenance of some but not all processes or interactions, or lacks reference to ISO/IEC 42001 requirements
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes maintenance of a management system for a different topic, or only describes maintenance plans without evidence of ongoing activity

requirements.text: The organization shall continually improve an AI management system, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with the requirements of this document.
requirements.subject: the continual improvement of the AI management system and its processes and interactions
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a defined process for continual improvement of the AI management system and its processes and interactions, referencing ISO/IEC 42001 requirements
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes improvement activities for some but not all processes or interactions, or lacks reference to ISO/IEC 42001 requirements
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes improvement of a management system for a different topic, or only describes intentions without a defined process

requirements.text: The organization shall document an AI management system, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with the requirements of this document.
requirements.subject: the documentation of the AI management system and its processes and interactions
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences the existence of documented information describing the AI management system, its processes, their interactions, and alignment with ISO/IEC 42001 requirements
requirements.partial_when: a passage evidences documentation of some but not all processes or interactions, or lacks reference to ISO/IEC 42001 requirements
requirements.unmet_when: a passage evidences documentation of a management system for a different topic, or only references undocumented practices

requirements.text: Top management shall ensure that the AI policy and AI objectives are established and are compatible with the strategic direction of the organization
requirements.subject: establishment and compatibility of AI policy and AI objectives with strategic direction
requirements.met_when: a passage shows that top management has established the AI policy and AI objectives, and confirms their compatibility with the organization's strategic direction (e.g., explicit statements, board minutes, signed policy documents referencing strategic direction)
requirements.partial_when: only the establishment of AI policy or objectives is shown, but not their compatibility with strategic direction; or compatibility is asserted for only one (policy or objectives)
requirements.unmet_when: statements about establishing AI policy or objectives without reference to strategic direction; statements about strategic direction without mention of AI policy or objectives; references to other policies or objectives not related to AI
look_for: References to core activities or purposes of the organization as part of strategic direction

requirements.text: Top management shall ensure the integration of the AI management system requirements into the organization’s business processes
requirements.subject: integration of AI management system requirements into business processes
requirements.met_when: a passage demonstrates that AI management system requirements are incorporated into business processes (e.g., process maps, integration statements, workflow documentation showing AI requirements embedded)
requirements.partial_when: integration is shown for some but not all relevant business processes; or only an intention to integrate is stated
requirements.unmet_when: statements about business processes without mention of AI management system requirements; statements about AI management system requirements without reference to business processes; references to integration in unrelated systems
look_for: Business interpreted broadly as core activities or purposes

requirements.text: Top management shall ensure that the resources needed for the AI management system are available
requirements.subject: availability of resources for the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage confirms that resources (personnel, financial, technical, etc.) required for the AI management system are made available (e.g., resource allocation statements, budget approvals, staffing plans)
requirements.partial_when: only some types of resources are addressed; or an intention to provide resources is stated without evidence of actual availability
requirements.unmet_when: statements about resources for other systems; statements about resource needs without confirmation of availability; references to AI management system without mention of resources

requirements.text: Top management shall communicate the importance of effective AI management and of conforming to the AI management system requirements
requirements.subject: communication of importance of effective AI management and conformity to AI management system requirements
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that top management has communicated (e.g., emails, presentations, meeting minutes, internal memos) the importance of effective AI management and the need to conform to AI management system requirements
requirements.partial_when: communication covers only one aspect (either effective AI management or conformity to requirements); or an intention to communicate is stated without evidence of actual communication
requirements.unmet_when: statements about communication of unrelated topics; statements about AI management or requirements without evidence of communication; references to communication plans without evidence of execution
look_for: Culture of responsible approach to AI use, development, and governance

requirements.text: Top management shall ensure that the AI management system achieves its intended result(s)
requirements.subject: achievement of intended results of the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage demonstrates that top management has determined whether the AI management system achieves its intended results (e.g., performance reviews, outcome assessments, management review minutes)
requirements.partial_when: only partial achievement is evidenced; or only an intention to monitor achievement is stated
requirements.unmet_when: statements about intended results without evidence of achievement; statements about achievement in unrelated systems; references to AI management system without mention of results

requirements.text: Top management shall direct and support persons to contribute to the effectiveness of the AI management system
requirements.subject: direction and support for persons to contribute to AI management system effectiveness
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that top management has directed and supported persons (e.g., staff, teams) to contribute to the effectiveness of the AI management system (e.g., directives, support statements, training records, resource provision)
requirements.partial_when: only direction or only support is evidenced; or only some persons are addressed
requirements.unmet_when: statements about direction or support in unrelated systems; statements about AI management system effectiveness without evidence of direction or support; references to plans without evidence of action
look_for: Modelling a culture of responsible approach to AI

requirements.text: Top management shall promote continual improvement
requirements.subject: promotion of continual improvement
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that top management has promoted continual improvement (e.g., improvement initiatives, communications, process reviews, encouragement statements)
requirements.partial_when: only an intention to promote continual improvement is stated; or only one improvement initiative is evidenced without ongoing promotion
requirements.unmet_when: statements about improvement in unrelated systems; statements about continual improvement without evidence of promotion; references to improvement plans without evidence of action

requirements.text: Top management shall support other relevant roles to demonstrate their leadership as it applies to their areas of responsibility
requirements.subject: support for other relevant roles to demonstrate leadership in their areas of responsibility
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that top management has supported other relevant roles (e.g., department heads, project leads) to demonstrate leadership in their areas of responsibility (e.g., empowerment statements, delegation records, leadership development programs)
requirements.partial_when: only some relevant roles are supported; or only an intention to support is stated
requirements.unmet_when: statements about support for unrelated roles; statements about leadership without evidence of support; references to support plans without evidence of action
look_for: Ensuring awareness of and compliance with responsible approach to AI

requirements.text: Top management shall establish an AI policy that is appropriate to the purpose of the organization
requirements.subject: the AI policy's appropriateness to the organization's purpose
requirements.met_when: a passage demonstrates that the AI policy aligns with, supports, or is tailored to the organization's stated purpose, mission, or business context
requirements.partial_when: the AI policy is stated but only partially addresses the organization's purpose, or the purpose is referenced but not clearly linked to the policy
requirements.unmet_when: the AI policy is generic with no reference to the organization's purpose, or only the organization's purpose is described without linking to the AI policy
look_for: Considerations for organizations when developing AI policies are provided in ISO/IEC 38507.

requirements.text: Top management shall establish an AI policy that provides a framework for setting AI objectives (see 6.2)
requirements.subject: the AI policy's framework for setting AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage shows the AI policy includes principles, criteria, or structure for setting AI objectives, referencing how objectives are derived or guided
requirements.partial_when: the AI policy mentions objectives but lacks a clear framework or only provides partial guidance
requirements.unmet_when: the AI policy omits any mention of objectives or framework, or only lists objectives without a guiding framework
look_for: Considerations for organizations when developing AI policies are provided in ISO/IEC 38507.

requirements.text: Top management shall establish an AI policy that includes a commitment to meet applicable requirements
requirements.subject: the AI policy's commitment to meet applicable requirements
requirements.met_when: a passage in the AI policy explicitly states a commitment to comply with legal, regulatory, contractual, or other applicable requirements relevant to AI
requirements.partial_when: the AI policy references requirements but lacks a clear commitment, or only commits to some requirements
requirements.unmet_when: the AI policy omits any mention of applicable requirements, or only describes requirements without a commitment
look_for: Considerations for organizations when developing AI policies are provided in ISO/IEC 38507.

requirements.text: Top management shall establish an AI policy that includes a commitment to continual improvement of the AI management system
requirements.subject: the AI policy's commitment to continual improvement of the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage in the AI policy explicitly states a commitment to continual improvement of the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: the AI policy references improvement but lacks a clear commitment, or only commits to improvement in some areas
requirements.unmet_when: the AI policy omits any mention of continual improvement, or only describes improvement activities without a commitment
look_for: Considerations for organizations when developing AI policies are provided in ISO/IEC 38507.

requirements.text: The AI policy shall be available as documented information
requirements.subject: the AI policy as a document
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences the existence of a documented AI policy (e.g., a file, manual, or official document)
requirements.partial_when: a draft or incomplete version of the AI policy is available, or only a summary is documented
requirements.unmet_when: no documented AI policy exists, or only references to an undocumented policy are provided
look_for: Considerations for organizations when developing AI policies are provided in ISO/IEC 38507.

requirements.text: The AI policy shall refer as relevant to other organizational policies
requirements.subject: the AI policy's references to other organizational policies
requirements.met_when: a passage in the AI policy refers to other relevant organizational policies (e.g., information security, quality, ethics), showing linkage or alignment
requirements.partial_when: the AI policy references some but not all relevant policies, or only mentions policies without clear relevance
requirements.unmet_when: the AI policy omits any reference to other organizational policies, or references policies unrelated to AI
look_for: Considerations for organizations when developing AI policies are provided in ISO/IEC 38507.

requirements.text: The AI policy shall be communicated within the organization
requirements.subject: the AI policy - NOT any other policy
requirements.met_when: a passage states how THIS AI POLICY is communicated internally (publication, induction, mandatory training, attestation), or evidences that it was
requirements.partial_when: an intention to communicate is stated with no mechanism, or only future amendments are said to be communicated
requirements.unmet_when: nothing addresses communication of the AI policy. A statement about a DIFFERENT policy being communicated - the IMS Policy, the Quality Policy - is inadmissible
look_for: Considerations for organizations when developing AI policies are provided in ISO/IEC 38507.

requirements.text: The AI policy shall be available to interested parties, as appropriate
requirements.subject: the AI policy's availability to interested parties
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the AI policy is made available to relevant interested parties (e.g., customers, regulators, partners), with description of how and to whom
requirements.partial_when: the AI policy is available to some but not all appropriate interested parties, or only an intention to make it available is stated
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence the AI policy is available to interested parties, or only internal availability is described
look_for: Considerations for organizations when developing AI policies are provided in ISO/IEC 38507.

requirements.text: Responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned within the organization
requirements.subject: assignment of responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies specific roles and states that responsibilities and authorities have been assigned to those roles
requirements.partial_when: roles are listed but responsibilities and authorities are only partially assigned, or only some relevant roles are covered
requirements.unmet_when: no assignment of responsibilities and authorities is described, or only a general statement about roles without specifying assignment
look_for: A control for defining and allocating roles and responsibilities is provided in A.3.2 in Table A.1. Implementation guidance for this control is provided in B.3.2.

requirements.text: Responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are communicated within the organization
requirements.subject: communication of assigned responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that assigned responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles have been communicated (e.g., via internal memos, training, publication, or attestation)
requirements.partial_when: an intention to communicate is stated but no evidence of actual communication, or only some roles' responsibilities and authorities are communicated
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence of communication, or communication about unrelated topics (e.g., general organizational structure)
look_for: A control for defining and allocating roles and responsibilities is provided in A.3.2 in Table A.1. Implementation guidance for this control is provided in B.3.2.

requirements.text: Responsibility and authority are assigned for ensuring that the AI management system conforms to the requirements of this document
requirements.subject: assignment of responsibility and authority for AI management system conformity
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies a specific role or person assigned responsibility and authority for ensuring conformity to ISO/IEC 42001:2023
requirements.partial_when: responsibility or authority is assigned but not both, or assignment is implied but not explicit
requirements.unmet_when: no assignment is made, or assignment is for a different standard or system
look_for: A control for defining and allocating roles and responsibilities is provided in A.3.2 in Table A.1. Implementation guidance for this control is provided in B.3.2.

requirements.text: Responsibility and authority are assigned for reporting on the performance of the AI management system to top management
requirements.subject: assignment of responsibility and authority for reporting AI management system performance
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies a specific role or person assigned responsibility and authority for reporting on AI management system performance to top management
requirements.partial_when: responsibility or authority is assigned but not both, or assignment is implied but not explicit
requirements.unmet_when: no assignment is made, or assignment is for reporting on a different system or to a different audience
look_for: A control for defining and allocating roles and responsibilities is provided in A.3.2 in Table A.1. Implementation guidance for this control is provided in B.3.2.

6.1.1.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities - General

requirements.text: The organization shall consider the issues referred to in 4.1 and the requirements referred to in 4.2 when planning for the AI management system
requirements.subject: issues from 4.1 and requirements from 4.2 in AI management system planning
requirements.met_when: a passage shows the organization has reviewed and taken into account the issues from clause 4.1 and requirements from clause 4.2 during AI management system planning
requirements.partial_when: only issues from 4.1 OR requirements from 4.2 are considered, not both
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence that either 4.1 or 4.2 are considered; evidence refers to unrelated issues or requirements

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the risks and opportunities that need to be addressed to give assurance that the AI management system can achieve its intended result(s)
requirements.subject: risks and opportunities related to achieving intended results of the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies specific risks and opportunities that, if addressed, will help assure the AI management system achieves its intended results
requirements.partial_when: risks or opportunities are identified but not linked to achieving intended results
requirements.unmet_when: risks and opportunities are not determined, or only general statements about assurance are made without specifics

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the risks and opportunities that need to be addressed to prevent or reduce undesired effects
requirements.subject: risks and opportunities related to preventing or reducing undesired effects
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies risks and opportunities that, if addressed, will prevent or reduce undesired effects from the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: risks or opportunities are identified but not linked to undesired effects
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence of risks and opportunities determined for undesired effects; only general statements about prevention or reduction

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the risks and opportunities that need to be addressed to achieve continual improvement
requirements.subject: risks and opportunities related to continual improvement
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies risks and opportunities that, if addressed, will support continual improvement of the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: risks or opportunities are identified but not linked to continual improvement
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence of risks and opportunities determined for continual improvement; only general statements about improvement

requirements.text: The organization shall establish and maintain AI risk criteria that support distinguishing acceptable from non-acceptable risks
requirements.subject: AI risk criteria for distinguishing acceptable from non-acceptable risks
requirements.met_when: a document exists that defines criteria for distinguishing acceptable from non-acceptable AI risks
requirements.partial_when: criteria are defined but not maintained, or only partially distinguish risks
requirements.unmet_when: no criteria are documented; only general statements about risk acceptability
look_for: Considerations for risk appetite and tolerance from ISO/IEC 38507 and ISO/IEC 23894

requirements.text: The organization shall establish and maintain AI risk criteria that support performing AI risk assessments
requirements.subject: AI risk criteria for performing AI risk assessments
requirements.met_when: a document exists that defines criteria to be used in AI risk assessments
requirements.partial_when: criteria are defined but not maintained, or only partially support risk assessment
requirements.unmet_when: no criteria are documented; only general statements about risk assessment

requirements.text: The organization shall establish and maintain AI risk criteria that support conducting AI risk treatment
requirements.subject: AI risk criteria for conducting AI risk treatment
requirements.met_when: a document exists that defines criteria to guide AI risk treatment decisions
requirements.partial_when: criteria are defined but not maintained, or only partially support risk treatment
requirements.unmet_when: no criteria are documented; only general statements about risk treatment

requirements.text: The organization shall establish and maintain AI risk criteria that support assessing AI risk impacts
requirements.subject: AI risk criteria for assessing AI risk impacts
requirements.met_when: a document exists that defines criteria for assessing the impacts of AI risks
requirements.partial_when: criteria are defined but not maintained, or only partially support impact assessment
requirements.unmet_when: no criteria are documented; only general statements about risk impacts

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the risks and opportunities according to the domain and application context of an AI system
requirements.subject: risks and opportunities based on domain and application context
requirements.met_when: a passage shows risks and opportunities are determined with explicit reference to the domain and application context of the AI system
requirements.partial_when: domain or application context is mentioned but not used in determination
requirements.unmet_when: risks and opportunities are determined without reference to domain or application context

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the risks and opportunities according to the intended use
requirements.subject: risks and opportunities based on intended use
requirements.met_when: a passage shows risks and opportunities are determined with explicit reference to the intended use of the AI system
requirements.partial_when: intended use is mentioned but not used in determination
requirements.unmet_when: risks and opportunities are determined without reference to intended use

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the risks and opportunities according to the external and internal context described in 4.1
requirements.subject: risks and opportunities based on external and internal context from 4.1
requirements.met_when: a passage shows risks and opportunities are determined with explicit reference to the external and internal context described in clause 4.1
requirements.partial_when: external or internal context is mentioned but not used in determination
requirements.unmet_when: risks and opportunities are determined without reference to external and internal context
look_for: More than one AI system can be considered; determination is performed for each system or grouping

requirements.text: The organization shall plan actions to address these risks and opportunities
requirements.subject: actions planned to address identified risks and opportunities
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process or plan for actions to address the identified risks and opportunities
requirements.partial_when: actions are listed but no process or plan is described
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence of planning actions; only identification of risks and opportunities

requirements.text: The organization shall plan how to integrate and implement the actions into its AI management system processes
requirements.subject: integration and implementation of actions into AI management system processes
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how actions to address risks and opportunities are integrated and implemented into AI management system processes
requirements.partial_when: integration or implementation is mentioned but not described
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence of integration or implementation planning; only actions listed

requirements.text: The organization shall plan how to evaluate the effectiveness of these actions
requirements.subject: evaluation of effectiveness of actions addressing risks and opportunities
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process or method for evaluating the effectiveness of actions taken to address risks and opportunities
requirements.partial_when: evaluation is mentioned but no process or method is described
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence of evaluation planning; only actions listed

requirements.text: The organization shall retain documented information on actions taken to identify and address AI risks and AI opportunities
requirements.subject: documented information on actions taken to identify and address AI risks and opportunities
requirements.met_when: a record exists showing actions taken to identify and address AI risks and opportunities
requirements.partial_when: records exist for actions taken to identify OR address, but not both
requirements.unmet_when: no records of actions taken; only plans or intentions documented
look_for: Guidance on risk management implementation in ISO/IEC 23894
Context and sectoral definitions of risk may impact risk management activities

requirements.text: The organization shall define and establish an AI risk assessment process that is informed by and aligned with the AI policy and AI objectives.
requirements.subject: AI risk assessment process alignment with AI policy and AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage describes the AI risk assessment process and explicitly states it is informed by and aligned with the AI policy and AI objectives, referencing both documents or their contents.
requirements.partial_when: the process is described as aligned with only the AI policy or only the AI objectives, or alignment is stated as an intention without evidence of implementation.
requirements.unmet_when: the process is described without reference to the AI policy or AI objectives, or only general risk management is discussed without specific mention of AI policy/objectives.

requirements.text: The organization shall define and establish an AI risk assessment process that is designed such that repeated AI risk assessments can produce consistent, valid and comparable results.
requirements.subject: AI risk assessment process design for consistency, validity, and comparability
requirements.met_when: a passage describes the process design features (e.g., standardized methods, templates, criteria) that ensure repeated assessments yield consistent, valid, and comparable results.
requirements.partial_when: the process mentions consistency or comparability but lacks detail on how validity is ensured, or vice versa.
requirements.unmet_when: the process is described without mention of consistency, validity, or comparability, or only a general risk assessment process is described without these features.

requirements.text: The organization shall define and establish an AI risk assessment process that identifies risks that aid or prevent achieving its AI objectives.
requirements.subject: identification of risks relevant to achieving AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how the process identifies risks that could either support or hinder the achievement of the organization's AI objectives.
requirements.partial_when: the process describes identification of risks but only those that prevent achieving objectives, or only those that aid, not both.
requirements.unmet_when: the process describes risk identification in general terms without reference to AI objectives, or only identifies risks unrelated to AI objectives.

requirements.text: The organization shall define and establish an AI risk assessment process that analyses the AI risks to assess the potential consequences to the organization, individuals and societies that would result if the identified risks were to materialize.
requirements.subject: analysis of AI risks for potential consequences to organization, individuals, and societies
requirements.met_when: a passage describes the process for analyzing AI risks, specifically assessing potential consequences to the organization, individuals, and societies if risks materialize.
requirements.partial_when: the process describes assessment of consequences to only the organization, or only individuals, or only societies, not all three.
requirements.unmet_when: the process describes risk analysis without assessing consequences, or only assesses consequences for unrelated entities.
look_for: AI system impact assessment may be used for consequence assessment.

requirements.text: The organization shall define and establish an AI risk assessment process that analyses the AI risks to assess, where applicable, the realistic likelihood of the identified risks.
requirements.subject: analysis of AI risks for realistic likelihood
requirements.met_when: a passage describes the process for analyzing AI risks, including assessment of the realistic likelihood of identified risks where applicable.
requirements.partial_when: the process describes likelihood assessment but does not specify it is realistic or only applies it to some risks without justification.
requirements.unmet_when: the process omits likelihood assessment or only discusses likelihood in general terms without application to identified AI risks.

requirements.text: The organization shall define and establish an AI risk assessment process that analyses the AI risks to determine the levels of risk.
requirements.subject: analysis of AI risks to determine risk levels
requirements.met_when: a passage describes the process for analyzing AI risks and determining their levels (e.g., low, medium, high, or other scale).
requirements.partial_when: the process describes determination of risk levels for only some risks or only in general terms without a defined scale.
requirements.unmet_when: the process omits determination of risk levels or only describes risk analysis without assigning levels.

requirements.text: The organization shall define and establish an AI risk assessment process that evaluates the AI risks to compare the results of the risk analysis with the risk criteria.
requirements.subject: evaluation of AI risks by comparison with risk criteria
requirements.met_when: a passage describes the process for evaluating AI risks, specifically comparing risk analysis results with defined risk criteria (see 6.1.1).
requirements.partial_when: the process describes comparison with risk criteria but lacks detail on how the criteria are applied or only applies to some risks.
requirements.unmet_when: the process omits comparison with risk criteria or only describes evaluation in general terms without reference to risk criteria.

requirements.text: The organization shall define and establish an AI risk assessment process that evaluates the AI risks to prioritize the assessed risks for risk treatment.
requirements.subject: evaluation of AI risks for prioritization for risk treatment
requirements.met_when: a passage describes the process for evaluating AI risks and prioritizing them for risk treatment based on assessment results.
requirements.partial_when: the process describes prioritization but only for some risks or lacks detail on how prioritization is determined.
requirements.unmet_when: the process omits prioritization or only describes risk evaluation without prioritization for treatment.

requirements.text: The organization shall retain documented information about the AI risk assessment process.
requirements.subject: documented information about the AI risk assessment process
requirements.met_when: a passage states that documented information about the AI risk assessment process exists, such as a procedure, policy, or process description.
requirements.partial_when: a passage states an intention to retain documented information or references a draft or incomplete document.
requirements.unmet_when: no documented information is referenced, or only undocumented practices or oral descriptions are provided.

requirements.text: The organization shall define an AI risk treatment process to select appropriate AI risk treatment options.
requirements.subject: selection of AI risk treatment options
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a defined, repeatable process for selecting AI risk treatment options based on risk assessment results
requirements.partial_when: a process is described but lacks detail on how options are selected or only covers some types of risks
requirements.unmet_when: only a list of options is provided without a process, or a process for non-AI risks is described

requirements.text: The organization shall define an AI risk treatment process to determine all controls that are necessary to implement the AI risk treatment options chosen and compare the controls with those in Annex A to verify that no necessary controls have been omitted.
requirements.subject: determination and comparison of necessary controls for AI risk treatment options
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process for identifying necessary controls for chosen AI risk treatment options and comparing them with Annex A controls to ensure completeness
requirements.partial_when: the process describes determination of controls but omits comparison with Annex A, or vice versa
requirements.unmet_when: only a list of controls is provided without a process, or comparison is made to controls outside Annex A
look_for: Annex A provides reference controls for meeting organizational objectives and addressing risks related to the design and use of AI systems.

requirements.text: The organization shall define an AI risk treatment process to consider the controls from Annex A that are relevant for the implementation of the AI risk treatment options.
requirements.subject: consideration of relevant Annex A controls for AI risk treatment
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process for reviewing Annex A controls to determine their relevance to the implementation of selected AI risk treatment options
requirements.partial_when: the process mentions Annex A controls but does not specify how relevance is determined
requirements.unmet_when: controls from sources other than Annex A are considered without reference to Annex A, or only a list of controls is given

requirements.text: The organization shall define an AI risk treatment process to identify if additional controls are necessary beyond those in Annex A in order to implement all risk treatment options.
requirements.subject: identification of additional controls beyond Annex A for AI risk treatment
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process for identifying when controls beyond those listed in Annex A are needed to implement all risk treatment options
requirements.partial_when: the process identifies additional controls but does not specify how the need is determined
requirements.unmet_when: only Annex A controls are considered, or additional controls are listed without a process for identification
look_for: Annex A controls are not exhaustive and additional control objectives and controls can be needed.

requirements.text: The organization shall define an AI risk treatment process to consider the guidance in Annex B for the implementation of controls determined in b) and c).
requirements.subject: consideration of Annex B guidance for implementing controls
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process for consulting Annex B guidance when implementing controls determined in b) and c)
requirements.partial_when: Annex B is referenced but not integrated into the process, or only some controls are considered
requirements.unmet_when: Annex B guidance is not mentioned, or guidance from other sources is used instead

requirements.text: The organization shall produce a statement of applicability that contains the necessary controls [see b), c) and d)] and provide justification for inclusion and exclusion of controls.
requirements.subject: statement of applicability for necessary controls with justification
requirements.met_when: a document exists listing necessary controls, with explicit justification for each control's inclusion or exclusion
requirements.partial_when: the statement lists controls but lacks justification for inclusion or exclusion, or only covers some controls
requirements.unmet_when: a statement of applicability is referenced but not provided, or justification is missing entirely
look_for: The organization can provide documented justifications for excluding any control objectives in general or for specific AI systems, whether those listed in Annex A or established by the organization itself.

requirements.text: The organization shall formulate an AI risk treatment plan.
requirements.subject: AI risk treatment plan
requirements.met_when: a document exists that details the AI risk treatment plan, including actions, timelines, responsible parties, and controls
requirements.partial_when: a draft plan exists or only some elements (e.g., actions or controls) are documented
requirements.unmet_when: only a reference to a plan is provided, or a plan for non-AI risks is documented

requirements.text: The organization shall obtain approval from the designated management for the AI risk treatment plan and for acceptance of the residual AI risks.
requirements.subject: approval of AI risk treatment plan and acceptance of residual AI risks
requirements.met_when: a record exists showing designated management has approved the AI risk treatment plan and accepted residual AI risks
requirements.partial_when: approval is documented for the plan but not for residual risks, or vice versa
requirements.unmet_when: only an intention to seek approval is stated, or approval is from an incorrect authority

requirements.text: The necessary controls shall be aligned to the objectives in 6.2.
requirements.subject: alignment of necessary controls to objectives in 6.2
requirements.met_when: a passage demonstrates that necessary controls are mapped or linked to the objectives specified in clause 6.2
requirements.partial_when: alignment is shown for some controls or some objectives, but not all
requirements.unmet_when: controls are listed without reference to objectives, or objectives from another clause are used

requirements.text: The necessary controls shall be available as documented information.
requirements.subject: necessary controls for AI risk treatment
requirements.met_when: a document exists listing all necessary controls for AI risk treatment
requirements.partial_when: only some controls are documented, or a draft document exists
requirements.unmet_when: controls are referenced but not documented, or only controls for non-AI risks are documented

requirements.text: The necessary controls shall be communicated within the organization.
requirements.subject: communication of necessary controls for AI risk treatment
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that necessary controls have been communicated internally (e.g., via training, publication, meetings)
requirements.partial_when: an intention to communicate is stated, or only some controls are communicated
requirements.unmet_when: communication is about controls for non-AI risks, or only a procedure for communication exists without evidence it happened

requirements.text: The necessary controls shall be available to interested parties, as appropriate.
requirements.subject: availability of necessary controls to interested parties
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that necessary controls are made available to relevant interested parties (e.g., external stakeholders, regulators), as appropriate
requirements.partial_when: controls are available to some interested parties but not all relevant ones, or only an intention to make them available is stated
requirements.unmet_when: controls are not made available, or only internal communication is evidenced

requirements.text: The organization shall retain documented information about the AI risk treatment process.
requirements.subject: AI risk treatment process
requirements.met_when: a document exists describing the AI risk treatment process, including its steps and criteria
requirements.partial_when: only a draft or partial process is documented, or only some steps are described
requirements.unmet_when: the process is referenced but not documented, or documentation is about a non-AI risk treatment process

requirements.text: The organization shall define a process for assessing the potential consequences for individuals or groups of individuals, or both, and societies that can result from the development, provision or use of AI systems.
requirements.subject: assessment of potential consequences for individuals, groups, and societies from AI system development, provision, or use
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a defined, repeatable process for assessing potential consequences for individuals, groups, and societies arising from the development, provision, or use of AI systems
requirements.partial_when: the process is described for only one aspect (e.g., development but not provision or use), or only for individuals but not groups or societies
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes a responsibility to assess consequences but no process, or describes a process for a different type of assessment (e.g., risk assessment only), or references an unseen process
look_for: discipline-specific impact assessments (e.g. safety, privacy, security) may be required in some contexts

requirements.text: The AI system impact assessment shall determine the potential consequences an AI system’s deployment, intended use and foreseeable misuse has on individuals or groups of individuals, or both, and societies.
requirements.subject: potential consequences of AI system deployment, intended use, and foreseeable misuse on individuals, groups, and societies
requirements.met_when: a passage shows that the impact assessment determines the potential consequences of deployment, intended use, and foreseeable misuse of the AI system for individuals, groups, and societies
requirements.partial_when: the determination covers only deployment or intended use, but not foreseeable misuse, or only individuals but not groups or societies
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes only the process for assessment, or only identifies risks without determining consequences, or references an unseen determination
look_for: discipline-specific impact assessments (e.g. safety, privacy, security) may be required in some contexts

requirements.text: The AI system impact assessment shall take into account the specific technical and societal context where the AI system is deployed and applicable jurisdictions.
requirements.subject: technical and societal context and applicable jurisdictions for AI system deployment
requirements.met_when: a passage shows that the impact assessment considers the technical context, societal context, and applicable jurisdictions where the AI system is deployed
requirements.partial_when: the assessment considers only technical context or only societal context or only jurisdictions, but not all
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes context consideration for a different process, or only references context without showing it is taken into account in the impact assessment
look_for: discipline-specific impact assessments (e.g. safety, privacy, security) may be required in some contexts

requirements.text: The result of the AI system impact assessment shall be documented.
requirements.subject: result of the AI system impact assessment
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the result of the AI system impact assessment is documented (e.g., in a report, record, or other document)
requirements.partial_when: the result is documented for only part of the assessment (e.g., only for deployment, not for intended use or misuse)
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes the process or determination but does not document the result, or references an unseen document

requirements.text: Where appropriate, the result of the system impact assessment can be made available to relevant interested parties as defined by the organization.
requirements.subject: availability of the AI system impact assessment result to relevant interested parties
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the result of the impact assessment was made available to relevant interested parties, as defined by the organization, where appropriate
requirements.partial_when: a passage states an intention to make the result available but does not evidence it actually happened, or only some relevant parties received it
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes availability for a different assessment, or only references the possibility without evidence of actual availability

requirements.text: The organization shall consider the results of the AI system impact assessment in the risk assessment (see 6.1.2).
requirements.subject: consideration of AI system impact assessment results in the risk assessment
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the results of the AI system impact assessment were considered in the risk assessment process
requirements.partial_when: a passage states an intention to consider the results but does not evidence it actually happened, or only some results were considered
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes consideration of results in a different process, or only references the risk assessment without showing the impact assessment results were considered
look_for: discipline-specific impact assessments (e.g. safety, privacy, security) may be required in some contexts

6.2.title: AI objectives and planning to achieve them

requirements.text: The organization shall establish AI objectives at relevant functions and levels.
requirements.subject: AI objectives at relevant functions and levels
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies specific AI objectives and shows they are set for relevant functions and levels within the organization
requirements.partial_when: AI objectives are established for some functions or levels, but not all relevant ones
requirements.unmet_when: no AI objectives are established, or objectives are set only at the top level with no evidence for other relevant functions/levels

requirements.text: AI objectives shall be consistent with the AI policy.
requirements.subject: consistency between AI objectives and the AI policy
requirements.met_when: a passage demonstrates that the AI objectives align with the stated AI policy, referencing both and showing their relationship
requirements.partial_when: some objectives are shown to be consistent, but others are not addressed or are ambiguous
requirements.unmet_when: objectives are stated without reference to the AI policy, or objectives contradict the AI policy

requirements.text: AI objectives shall be measurable (if practicable).
requirements.subject: measurability of AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage shows that AI objectives include measurable criteria or metrics, or explains why measurement is not practicable
requirements.partial_when: some objectives are measurable, others lack metrics or justification for non-measurability
requirements.unmet_when: objectives are stated without any reference to measurement or practicability

requirements.text: AI objectives shall take into account applicable requirements.
requirements.subject: applicable requirements considered in AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage shows that AI objectives are set with reference to applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, or stakeholder requirements
requirements.partial_when: only some applicable requirements are considered, or requirements are referenced but not integrated into objectives
requirements.unmet_when: objectives are set without any reference to applicable requirements

requirements.text: AI objectives shall be monitored.
requirements.subject: monitoring of AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process or method for monitoring progress toward AI objectives
requirements.partial_when: monitoring is described for some objectives, or monitoring is planned but not implemented
requirements.unmet_when: no monitoring process is described, or monitoring is referenced only for non-AI objectives

requirements.text: AI objectives shall be communicated.
requirements.subject: communication of AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how AI objectives are communicated to relevant stakeholders, functions, or levels
requirements.partial_when: communication is described for some objectives or some stakeholders, or only an intention to communicate is stated
requirements.unmet_when: no communication process is described, or communication is referenced only for non-AI objectives

requirements.text: AI objectives shall be updated as appropriate.
requirements.subject: updating of AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process for reviewing and updating AI objectives when necessary
requirements.partial_when: updating is described for some objectives, or only an intention to update is stated
requirements.unmet_when: no updating process is described, or updating is referenced only for non-AI objectives

requirements.text: AI objectives shall be available as documented information.
requirements.subject: documented information about AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences the existence of documented information listing the AI objectives
requirements.partial_when: documented information exists for some objectives, but not all
requirements.unmet_when: no documented information about AI objectives is available, or only a reference to an unseen document is provided

requirements.text: When planning how to achieve its AI objectives, the organization shall determine what will be done.
requirements.subject: actions to achieve AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage specifies the actions, tasks, or steps that will be taken to achieve each AI objective
requirements.partial_when: actions are determined for some objectives, but not all
requirements.unmet_when: no actions are determined, or only general intentions are stated without specifics

requirements.text: When planning how to achieve its AI objectives, the organization shall determine what resources will be required.
requirements.subject: resources required to achieve AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies the resources (personnel, technology, budget, etc.) needed for each AI objective
requirements.partial_when: resources are determined for some objectives, but not all
requirements.unmet_when: no resources are determined, or only general statements about resource needs are made

requirements.text: When planning how to achieve its AI objectives, the organization shall determine who will be responsible.
requirements.subject: responsibility for achieving AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage assigns responsibility for achieving each AI objective to specific roles or individuals
requirements.partial_when: responsibility is assigned for some objectives, but not all
requirements.unmet_when: no responsibility is assigned, or only general statements about responsibility are made

requirements.text: When planning how to achieve its AI objectives, the organization shall determine when it will be completed.
requirements.subject: completion timelines for AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage specifies completion dates or timelines for each AI objective
requirements.partial_when: timelines are determined for some objectives, but not all
requirements.unmet_when: no completion timelines are determined, or only general statements about timing are made

requirements.text: When planning how to achieve its AI objectives, the organization shall determine how the results will be evaluated.
requirements.subject: evaluation of results for AI objectives
requirements.met_when: a passage describes the criteria or methods for evaluating whether AI objectives have been achieved
requirements.partial_when: evaluation methods are determined for some objectives, but not all
requirements.unmet_when: no evaluation methods are determined, or only general statements about evaluation are made
look_for: Annex C: risk management objectives
A.6.1 and A.9.3: control objectives and controls for responsible development and use of AI systems
B.6.1 and B.9.3: implementation guidance for controls

requirements.text: Changes to the AI management system are carried out in a planned manner when the organization determines the need for changes.
requirements.subject: changes to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a defined, repeatable process for planning and implementing changes to the AI management system, including steps or criteria for planning such changes when a need is determined
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes an intention to plan changes or references planning without detailing a process, or only describes planning for some types of changes but not all
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes changes being made without any reference to planning, or only describes who is responsible for changes without describing a process, or references a process for planning changes to a different management system (e.g., quality or information security) instead of the AI management system

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the AI management system.
requirements.subject: resources needed for the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how the organization identifies or assesses the resources required for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving the AI management system (e.g., personnel, infrastructure, technology, financial resources, etc.)
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes determination of resources for only some aspects (e.g., only establishment or only implementation), or only for part of the AI management system
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes provision of resources without evidence of determination, or determination of resources for a different management system (e.g., quality, information security), or references an unseen artefact
look_for: Control objectives and controls for AI resources are provided in A.4 in Table A.1. Implementation guidance for these controls is provided in Clause B.4.

requirements.text: The organization shall provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the AI management system.
requirements.subject: provision of resources for the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the organization has allocated or made available the resources identified as needed for the AI management system (e.g., budget allocation, staff assignment, procurement records, infrastructure deployment)
requirements.partial_when: a passage evidences provision of resources for only some aspects (e.g., only establishment or only implementation), or only for part of the AI management system
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes an intention to provide resources without evidence of actual provision, or provision of resources for a different management system, or references an unseen artefact
look_for: Control objectives and controls for AI resources are provided in A.4 in Table A.1. Implementation guidance for these controls is provided in Clause B.4.

requirements.text: Determine the necessary competence of person(s) doing work under its control that affects its AI performance
requirements.subject: necessary competence for persons affecting AI performance
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies the specific competence (knowledge, skills, abilities) required for roles or tasks that impact AI performance, and shows how these requirements were determined
requirements.partial_when: only some roles or tasks are covered, or competence is described in general terms without linking to AI performance
requirements.unmet_when: no determination of competence is shown; only a statement of responsibility or a generic HR policy; competence for unrelated roles (not affecting AI performance)
look_for: Implementation guidance for human resources including consideration of necessary expertise is provided in B.4.6.

requirements.text: Ensure that these persons are competent on the basis of appropriate education, training or experience
requirements.subject: ensuring competence of persons affecting AI performance
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process or method for verifying that persons in relevant roles have the required competence, referencing education, training, or experience
requirements.partial_when: a process is described but only for some relevant persons, or only one aspect (education, training, or experience) is considered
requirements.unmet_when: no process for ensuring competence is described; only a statement of required competence without verification; process for unrelated roles
look_for: Implementation guidance for human resources including consideration of necessary expertise is provided in B.4.6.

requirements.text: Where applicable, take actions to acquire the necessary competence, and evaluate the effectiveness of the actions taken
requirements.subject: actions to acquire competence and evaluation of their effectiveness
requirements.met_when: a passage describes actions taken (such as training, mentoring, reassignment, hiring, or contracting) to acquire necessary competence, and explains how the effectiveness of these actions is evaluated
requirements.partial_when: actions are described but no evaluation of effectiveness, or only some actions are covered
requirements.unmet_when: no actions or evaluation are described; only an intention to take action; actions for unrelated competence
look_for: Applicable actions can include, for example: the provision of training to, the mentoring of, or the re-assignment of currently employed persons; or the hiring or contracting of competent persons.

requirements.text: Appropriate documented information shall be available as evidence of competence
requirements.subject: evidence of competence for persons affecting AI performance
requirements.met_when: a passage references or presents documented information (such as certificates, training records, experience logs, or qualification documents) that evidences the competence of persons in relevant roles
requirements.partial_when: evidence is available for only some relevant persons or only some aspects of competence
requirements.unmet_when: no documented evidence is available; only a process or policy is described; evidence for unrelated roles

requirements.text: Persons doing work under the organization’s control shall be aware of the AI policy (see 5.2)
requirements.subject: awareness of the AI policy by persons under the organization's control
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that persons under the organization's control have been made aware of the AI policy, such as attendance records for policy briefings, signed attestations, training completion records, or documented acknowledgements specifically referencing the AI policy
requirements.partial_when: a statement of intent to make persons aware of the AI policy, or evidence that only some relevant persons have been made aware, or evidence that only future hires will be made aware
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence of awareness of the AI policy by persons under the organization's control; evidence relates to awareness of a different policy; evidence only describes the policy without showing awareness by persons

requirements.text: Persons doing work under the organization’s control shall be aware of their contribution to the effectiveness of the AI management system, including the benefits of improved AI performance
requirements.subject: awareness by persons under the organization's control of their contribution to the effectiveness of the AI management system and the benefits of improved AI performance
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that persons under the organization's control have been made aware of how their actions contribute to the effectiveness of the AI management system and the benefits of improved AI performance, such as training records, communication materials, or documented acknowledgements referencing these points
requirements.partial_when: a statement of intent to make persons aware, or evidence that only some persons have been made aware, or evidence that only one aspect (contribution or benefits) has been covered
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence of awareness of contribution or benefits; evidence relates to general AI awareness without reference to contribution or benefits; evidence only describes the management system without showing awareness by persons

requirements.text: Persons doing work under the organization’s control shall be aware of the implications of not conforming with the AI management system requirements
requirements.subject: awareness by persons under the organization's control of the implications of not conforming with AI management system requirements
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that persons under the organization's control have been made aware of the consequences or implications of not conforming with AI management system requirements, such as training materials, communication records, or documented acknowledgements referencing these implications
requirements.partial_when: a statement of intent to make persons aware, or evidence that only some persons have been made aware, or evidence that only future hires will be made aware
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence of awareness of implications; evidence relates to general AI management system requirements without reference to implications; evidence only describes the requirements without showing awareness by persons

requirements.text: The organization shall determine what it will communicate relevant to the AI management system
requirements.subject: the content of communications relevant to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies specific topics, messages, or information to be communicated internally or externally about the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: only some relevant communication topics are identified, or a general intention to communicate is stated without specifying what will be communicated
requirements.unmet_when: no determination of communication content is present, or the passage only describes communication about unrelated management systems or policies

requirements.text: The organization shall determine when to communicate relevant to the AI management system
requirements.subject: timing or frequency of communications relevant to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage specifies the timing, frequency, or triggers for communications (e.g., regular updates, upon changes, at project milestones) about the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: only some communication timings are specified, or a general statement about communicating 'as needed' without further detail
requirements.unmet_when: no determination of communication timing is present, or the passage only describes timing for unrelated communications

requirements.text: The organization shall determine with whom to communicate relevant to the AI management system
requirements.subject: audiences or recipients of communications relevant to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies specific internal or external parties, groups, or roles to receive communications about the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: only some relevant recipients are identified, or a general statement about communicating with 'stakeholders' without specifying who
requirements.unmet_when: no determination of communication recipients is present, or the passage only describes recipients for unrelated communications

requirements.text: The organization shall determine how to communicate relevant to the AI management system
requirements.subject: methods or channels for communications relevant to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage specifies the means, methods, or channels (e.g., email, meetings, intranet, reports) used for communicating about the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: only some communication methods are specified, or a general statement about using 'appropriate channels' without further detail
requirements.unmet_when: no determination of communication methods is present, or the passage only describes methods for unrelated communications

requirements.text: The organization’s AI management system includes documented information required by ISO/IEC 42001:2023
requirements.subject: documented information required by ISO/IEC 42001:2023
requirements.met_when: a passage lists or presents documents explicitly required by ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (e.g., AI policy, risk assessment, objectives, procedures, records), showing they are included in the AI management system
