requirements.partial_when: only some required documents are listed or presented, or there is an intention to include them but not evidence of their existence
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence of required documents being included, or only documents required by other standards or policies are referenced, or a cross-reference to an unseen artefact is given
look_for: The extent of documented information can differ due to organization size, activities, process complexity, and competence

requirements.text: The organization’s AI management system includes documented information determined by the organization as necessary for its effectiveness
requirements.subject: documented information determined by the organization as necessary for the effectiveness of the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage lists or presents documents that the organization has decided are necessary for the effectiveness of its AI management system, such as additional procedures, guidelines, or records beyond those required by the standard
requirements.partial_when: only some necessary documents are listed or presented, or there is an intention to include them but not evidence of their existence
requirements.unmet_when: no evidence of organization-determined necessary documents being included, or only required documents are referenced with no mention of additional necessary ones, or a cross-reference to an unseen artefact is given
look_for: The extent of documented information can differ due to organization size, activities, process complexity, and competence

requirements.text: When creating and updating documented information, the organization shall ensure appropriate identification and description (e.g. a title, date, author or reference number)
requirements.subject: identification and description of documented information
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process or procedure that ensures all documented information is assigned appropriate identification and description, such as title, date, author, or reference number, whenever it is created or updated
requirements.partial_when: the process is described for only some types of documented information, or only some elements (e.g. title but not date or author) are ensured
requirements.unmet_when: no process is described for identification and description, or the process is for a different type of information (e.g. records, not documented information), or only a responsibility is assigned without a defined process

requirements.text: When creating and updating documented information, the organization shall ensure appropriate format (e.g. language, software version, graphics) and media (e.g. paper, electronic)
requirements.subject: format and media of documented information
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process or procedure that ensures all documented information is created and updated in appropriate formats (such as language, software version, graphics) and media (such as paper or electronic), with criteria or controls specified
requirements.partial_when: the process is described for only format or only media, or only for some types of documented information
requirements.unmet_when: no process is described for format and media, or the process is for a different type of information, or only a responsibility is assigned without a defined process

requirements.text: When creating and updating documented information, the organization shall ensure appropriate review and approval for suitability and adequacy
requirements.subject: review and approval of documented information for suitability and adequacy
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process or procedure that ensures all documented information is reviewed and approved for suitability and adequacy before it is finalized or updated, including criteria for review and approval
requirements.partial_when: the process is described for only review or only approval, or only for some types of documented information
requirements.unmet_when: no process is described for review and approval, or the process is for a different type of information, or only a responsibility is assigned without a defined process

requirements.text: Documented information required by the AI management system and by this document shall be controlled to ensure it is available and suitable for use, where and when it is needed
requirements.subject: control of documented information required by the AI management system and ISO/IEC 42001:2023
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process or mechanism ensuring that documented information required by the AI management system and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 is available and suitable for use at the necessary locations and times
requirements.partial_when: the process is described for only some types of documented information, or only for availability but not suitability, or only for some locations/times
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes availability or suitability for documented information NOT required by the AI management system or this document, or only states a responsibility without describing a process

requirements.text: Documented information required by the AI management system and by this document shall be controlled to ensure it is adequately protected (e.g. from loss of confidentiality, improper use or loss of integrity)
requirements.subject: protection of documented information required by the AI management system and ISO/IEC 42001:2023
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process or mechanism ensuring adequate protection of documented information required by the AI management system and ISO/IEC 42001:2023, including protection from loss of confidentiality, improper use, or loss of integrity
requirements.partial_when: the process is described for only some types of protection (e.g. only confidentiality, not integrity), or only for some documented information
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes protection for documented information NOT required by the AI management system or this document, or only states a responsibility without describing a process

requirements.text: The organization shall address distribution, access, retrieval and use of documented information, as applicable
requirements.subject: distribution, access, retrieval and use of documented information
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how the organization manages distribution, access, retrieval, and use of documented information, including any controls or procedures
requirements.partial_when: only some activities (e.g. only access and retrieval) are described, or only some types of documented information are covered
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes distribution, access, retrieval, or use for information NOT considered documented information, or only states a responsibility without describing a process
look_for: Access can imply a decision regarding the permission to view the documented information only, or the permission and authority to view and change the documented information.

requirements.text: The organization shall address storage and preservation, including preservation of legibility, of documented information, as applicable
requirements.subject: storage and preservation of documented information, including legibility
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how the organization manages storage and preservation of documented information, including measures to preserve legibility
requirements.partial_when: only storage or only preservation (not both) is described, or only some types of documented information are covered
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes storage or preservation for information NOT considered documented information, or only states a responsibility without describing a process

requirements.text: The organization shall address control of changes (e.g. version control) of documented information, as applicable
requirements.subject: control of changes to documented information, including version control
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how the organization manages changes to documented information, including version control or similar mechanisms
requirements.partial_when: only some aspects of change control (e.g. only version control, not approval of changes) are described, or only some types of documented information are covered
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes change control for information NOT considered documented information, or only states a responsibility without describing a process

requirements.text: The organization shall address retention and disposition of documented information, as applicable
requirements.subject: retention and disposition of documented information
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how the organization manages retention and disposition of documented information, including retention periods and disposal methods
requirements.partial_when: only retention or only disposition (not both) is described, or only some types of documented information are covered
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes retention or disposition for information NOT considered documented information, or only states a responsibility without describing a process

requirements.text: Documented information of external origin determined by the organization to be necessary for the planning and operation of the AI management system shall be identified as appropriate and controlled
requirements.subject: identification and control of documented information of external origin necessary for the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how the organization identifies and controls documented information of external origin that is necessary for the planning and operation of the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: only identification or only control (not both) is described, or only some types of external documented information are covered
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes identification or control for external information NOT determined as necessary for the AI management system, or only states a responsibility without describing a process

requirements.text: The organization shall plan, implement and control the processes needed to meet requirements, and to implement the actions determined in Clause 6.
requirements.subject: operational planning, implementation and control of processes needed to meet requirements and implement actions from Clause 6
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a defined, repeatable process for planning, implementing, and controlling processes to meet requirements and actions from Clause 6
requirements.partial_when: only planning or only implementation or only control is described, or the process is described for some but not all requirements/actions from Clause 6
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes unrelated processes, or only assigns responsibility without describing a process, or references an unseen process

requirements.text: The organization shall establish criteria for the processes.
requirements.subject: criteria for operational processes
requirements.met_when: a passage specifies the criteria used to judge or control operational processes
requirements.partial_when: criteria are stated for some but not all processes, or criteria are described in general terms without specifics
requirements.unmet_when: criteria are not mentioned, or only a process is described without criteria, or criteria are referenced but not shown

requirements.text: The organization shall implement control of the processes in accordance with the criteria.
requirements.subject: control of operational processes according to established criteria
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how operational processes are controlled in line with the established criteria
requirements.partial_when: controls are described for some but not all processes, or controls are described but not linked to criteria
requirements.unmet_when: controls are described without reference to criteria, or only criteria are described without controls, or controls are referenced but not shown

requirements.text: The organization shall implement the controls determined according to 6.1.3 that are related to the operation of the AI management system.
requirements.subject: implementation of controls from 6.1.3 related to AI management system operation
requirements.met_when: a passage describes how controls determined in 6.1.3 are implemented in the operation of the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: controls from 6.1.3 are implemented for some but not all relevant operations, or implementation is described in general terms without specifics
requirements.unmet_when: controls from 6.1.3 are not mentioned, or only referenced without evidence of implementation, or controls are described for unrelated systems
look_for: Annex A lists reference controls and Annex B provides implementation guidance for them.

requirements.text: The effectiveness of these controls shall be monitored and corrective actions shall be considered if the intended results are not achieved.
requirements.subject: monitoring effectiveness of controls and considering corrective actions
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process for monitoring the effectiveness of controls and considering corrective actions when results are not achieved
requirements.partial_when: monitoring is described but not corrective actions, or corrective actions are described but not monitoring, or only some controls are covered
requirements.unmet_when: no process for monitoring or corrective actions is described, or only responsibility is assigned, or only references to monitoring/corrective actions without evidence
look_for: Annex A lists reference controls and Annex B provides implementation guidance for them.

requirements.text: Documented information shall be available to the extent necessary to have confidence that the processes have been carried out as planned.
requirements.subject: evidence that operational processes have been carried out as planned
requirements.met_when: a passage provides or describes documented information that shows operational processes were carried out as planned
requirements.partial_when: documented information is available for some but not all processes, or only partial evidence is provided
requirements.unmet_when: no documented information is available, or only references to documentation without evidence, or documentation is about unrelated processes

requirements.text: The organization shall control planned changes and review the consequences of unintended changes, taking action to mitigate any adverse effects, as necessary.
requirements.subject: control of planned changes and review/mitigation of unintended changes in operational processes
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process for controlling planned changes, reviewing unintended changes, and taking action to mitigate adverse effects
requirements.partial_when: only planned changes are controlled, or only unintended changes are reviewed, or mitigation actions are described for some but not all adverse effects
requirements.unmet_when: no process for controlling changes or reviewing consequences is described, or only responsibility is assigned, or only references to change control without evidence

requirements.text: The organization shall ensure that externally provided processes, products or services that are relevant to the AI management system are controlled.
requirements.subject: control of externally provided processes, products or services relevant to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process for controlling externally provided processes, products or services relevant to the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: controls are described for some but not all externally provided items, or only general statements about control without specifics
requirements.unmet_when: no process for controlling externally provided items is described, or only responsibility is assigned, or only references to control without evidence

requirements.text: AI risk assessments are performed in accordance with 6.1.2 at planned intervals or when significant changes are proposed or occur
requirements.subject: AI risk assessments performed - NOT risk assessments for other systems or processes
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that AI risk assessments have actually been carried out, showing they follow the process described in 6.1.2, and that they occur either at planned intervals or in response to significant changes
requirements.partial_when: a passage shows AI risk assessments are planned or intended, but does not evidence they have actually been performed; or only some assessments are evidenced (e.g., only at planned intervals, not when changes occur)
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes a process for risk assessment but does not evidence actual performance; or references risk assessments for non-AI systems; or only cross-references an unseen artefact

requirements.text: The organization retains documented information of the results of all AI risk assessments
requirements.subject: results of AI risk assessments - NOT the process or plan, but the actual outcomes
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that documented information exists and is retained about the results of every AI risk assessment performed
requirements.partial_when: a passage evidences retention of documented information for only some AI risk assessments, or states an intention to retain but does not show actual retention
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes the process or procedure for risk assessment but does not evidence retention of results; or references retention of results for non-AI risk assessments; or only cross-references an unseen artefact

requirements.text: The organization shall implement the AI risk treatment plan according to 6.1.3 and verify its effectiveness.
requirements.subject: implementation and verification of the AI risk treatment plan as specified in 6.1.3
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the AI risk treatment plan has been put into operation and that its effectiveness has been checked (e.g., through monitoring, testing, review, or evaluation of outcomes)
requirements.partial_when: a passage shows the plan was implemented but does not show verification of effectiveness, or vice versa
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the plan or its intended implementation, or only references 6.1.3 without evidence of action; evidence of implementation or verification for a different plan is inadmissible

requirements.text: When risk assessments identify new risks that require treatment, a risk treatment process in accordance with 6.1.3 shall be performed for these risks.
requirements.subject: performance of the risk treatment process for newly identified risks, in accordance with 6.1.3
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that, when new risks are identified by risk assessments, the risk treatment process (as defined in 6.1.3) is carried out for those risks
requirements.partial_when: a passage shows the process was initiated for some new risks but not all, or only describes an intention to perform the process
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the identification of new risks without evidence of treatment, or describes treatment for risks not newly identified, or references the process without evidence it was performed

requirements.text: When risk treatment options as defined by the risk treatment plan are not effective, these treatment options shall be reviewed and revalidated following the risk treatment process according to 6.1.3 and the risk treatment plan shall be updated.
requirements.subject: review, revalidation, and updating of risk treatment options and the risk treatment plan when options are found ineffective
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that ineffective risk treatment options are reviewed and revalidated using the process in 6.1.3, and that the risk treatment plan is updated accordingly
requirements.partial_when: a passage shows review or revalidation occurred but not updating of the plan, or vice versa; or only some ineffective options are addressed
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the identification of ineffective options without evidence of review, revalidation, or updating; or references the process or plan without evidence of action

requirements.text: The organization shall retain documented information of the results of all AI risk treatments.
requirements.subject: results of all AI risk treatments
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that documented information exists and is retained about the results of every AI risk treatment performed
requirements.partial_when: a passage shows documented information is retained for some but not all AI risk treatments, or only describes an intention to retain such information
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the risk treatment process or results without evidence of documentation or retention, or references documentation for non-AI risk treatments

requirements.text: The organization shall perform AI system impact assessments according to 6.1.4 at planned intervals or when significant changes are proposed to occur.
requirements.subject: AI system impact assessments - performed at planned intervals or when significant changes are proposed
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a repeatable process for conducting AI system impact assessments, specifying that assessments are done at scheduled intervals and/or when significant changes to the AI system are proposed, and referencing the criteria or method from 6.1.4
requirements.partial_when: the process is described for only one trigger (e.g., only at planned intervals or only for significant changes), or the process is stated but lacks reference to 6.1.4 criteria
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes impact assessments for non-AI systems, or only states a responsibility to perform assessments without describing the process, or references an external process without showing its existence

requirements.text: The organization shall retain documented information of the results of all AI system impact assessments.
requirements.subject: results of AI system impact assessments
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that documented information (records) of the results from every AI system impact assessment is retained and accessible
requirements.partial_when: records are retained for only some assessments, or retention is stated as an intention but not evidenced
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes the process of performing assessments but does not mention retention of results, or references retention of results for non-AI system assessments, or only refers to retention of the assessment process rather than its results

requirements.text: The organization shall determine what needs to be monitored and measured
requirements.subject: items, processes, or aspects of the AI management system that require monitoring and measurement
requirements.met_when: a passage identifies specific elements, processes, or outcomes within the AI management system that are to be monitored and measured
requirements.partial_when: only some relevant items or processes are identified, or the determination is stated as a future intention
requirements.unmet_when: no determination is made, or only a general statement about monitoring and measurement is provided without specifying what is to be monitored and measured

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation, as applicable, to ensure valid results
requirements.subject: methods used for monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation of the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage specifies the methods, tools, or techniques to be used for monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation, and addresses how validity of results is ensured
requirements.partial_when: methods are identified for only some activities, or validity is not addressed for all methods
requirements.unmet_when: no methods are specified, or only a general statement about using methods is provided without details, or validity is not considered

requirements.text: The organization shall determine when the monitoring and measuring shall be performed
requirements.subject: timing or frequency of monitoring and measuring activities for the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage specifies the schedule, frequency, or triggers for monitoring and measuring activities
requirements.partial_when: timing is specified for only some activities, or only general intervals are given without specifics
requirements.unmet_when: no timing is specified, or only a general statement about monitoring and measuring is provided without reference to when

requirements.text: The organization shall determine when the results from monitoring and measurement shall be analysed and evaluated
requirements.subject: timing or frequency of analysis and evaluation of monitoring and measurement results
requirements.met_when: a passage specifies when the results will be analysed and evaluated, such as after each monitoring event, at regular intervals, or upon certain triggers
requirements.partial_when: timing is specified for only some results, or only general intervals are given without specifics
requirements.unmet_when: no timing is specified, or only a general statement about analysis and evaluation is provided without reference to when

requirements.text: Documented information shall be available as evidence of the results
requirements.subject: results of monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation activities
requirements.met_when: a passage provides or references documented evidence (records, reports, logs) showing the results of monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation
requirements.partial_when: records are available for only some activities or results, or evidence is incomplete
requirements.unmet_when: no documented evidence is available, or only a description of the process is provided without actual results

requirements.text: The organization shall evaluate the performance and the effectiveness of the AI management system
requirements.subject: evaluation of performance and effectiveness of the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a defined process or method for evaluating both the performance and effectiveness of the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: only performance or only effectiveness is addressed, or the process is described as an intention rather than an established practice
requirements.unmet_when: no process is described, or only a general statement about evaluation is provided without specifics, or only responsibilities are assigned without a process

requirements.text: Internal audits are conducted at planned intervals to provide information on whether the AI management system conforms to the organization’s own requirements for its AI management system.
requirements.subject: internal audits of the AI management system against the organization’s own requirements
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that internal audits have been conducted, at planned intervals, specifically to assess conformity of the AI management system to the organization’s own requirements (audit reports, schedules, findings, or minutes referencing this criterion)
requirements.partial_when: audit activity is described but only some audits address the organization’s own requirements, or intervals are not planned but audits have occurred
requirements.unmet_when: audits are described but do not reference the organization’s own requirements, or only reference other standards or requirements; a plan to audit is stated but no evidence of actual audits

requirements.text: Internal audits are conducted at planned intervals to provide information on whether the AI management system conforms to the requirements of ISO/IEC 42001:2023.
requirements.subject: internal audits of the AI management system against ISO/IEC 42001:2023 requirements
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that internal audits have been conducted, at planned intervals, specifically to assess conformity of the AI management system to the requirements of ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (audit reports, schedules, findings, or minutes referencing this criterion)
requirements.partial_when: audit activity is described but only some audits address ISO/IEC 42001:2023 requirements, or intervals are not planned but audits have occurred
requirements.unmet_when: audits are described but do not reference ISO/IEC 42001:2023 requirements, or only reference other standards or requirements; a plan to audit is stated but no evidence of actual audits

requirements.text: Internal audits are conducted at planned intervals to provide information on whether the AI management system is effectively implemented and maintained.
requirements.subject: internal audits of the effective implementation and maintenance of the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that internal audits have been conducted, at planned intervals, specifically to assess whether the AI management system is effectively implemented and maintained (audit reports, schedules, findings, or minutes referencing this criterion)
requirements.partial_when: audit activity is described but only some audits address effective implementation and maintenance, or intervals are not planned but audits have occurred
requirements.unmet_when: audits are described but do not reference effective implementation and maintenance, or only reference conformity; a plan to audit is stated but no evidence of actual audits

requirements.text: The organization shall plan, establish, implement and maintain (an) audit programme(s), including the frequency, methods, responsibilities, planning requirements and reporting.
requirements.subject: internal audit programme(s) covering frequency, methods, responsibilities, planning requirements and reporting
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a repeatable process for internal audit programme(s) that includes how often audits occur, the methods used, who is responsible, how audits are planned, and how reporting is handled
requirements.partial_when: the process is described but omits one or more required elements (e.g., frequency is missing, or reporting is not addressed)
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes an audit programme without addressing any of the required elements, or only references an intention to create a programme, or describes an audit process for a different management system

requirements.text: When establishing the internal audit programme(s), the organization shall consider the importance of the processes concerned and the results of previous audits.
requirements.subject: consideration of process importance and previous audit results when establishing the internal audit programme(s)
requirements.met_when: a passage states that the importance of the processes and the results of previous audits are considered when establishing the internal audit programme(s), and describes how this is done
requirements.partial_when: only one factor (either process importance or previous audit results) is considered, or the passage states an intention to consider but does not describe how
requirements.unmet_when: no mention of consideration of process importance or previous audit results, or consideration is described for a different programme

requirements.text: The organization shall define the audit objectives, criteria and scope for each audit.
requirements.subject: audit objectives, criteria and scope for each audit
requirements.met_when: a passage defines the objectives, criteria and scope for each internal audit
requirements.partial_when: only one or two of the three (objectives, criteria, scope) are defined, or definitions are incomplete
requirements.unmet_when: no definitions are provided, or definitions are for audits outside the AI management system

requirements.text: The organization shall select auditors and conduct audits to ensure objectivity and the impartiality of the audit process.
requirements.subject: selection of auditors and conduct of audits ensuring objectivity and impartiality
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process for selecting auditors and conducting audits that ensures objectivity and impartiality (e.g., independence, avoidance of conflicts of interest)
requirements.partial_when: the process addresses only selection or only conduct, or objectivity/impartiality is mentioned but not ensured
requirements.unmet_when: auditor selection or audit conduct is described without reference to objectivity or impartiality, or the process is for a different management system

requirements.text: The organization shall ensure that the results of audits are reported to relevant managers.
requirements.subject: reporting of audit results to relevant managers
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a process that ensures audit results are reported to relevant managers (e.g., defined recipients, reporting channels)
requirements.partial_when: the process describes reporting but does not specify relevant managers, or only some audit results are reported
requirements.unmet_when: audit results are not reported, or reporting is described for a different management system

requirements.text: Documented information shall be available as evidence of the implementation of the audit programme(s) and the audit results.
requirements.subject: documented evidence of implementation of the audit programme(s) and audit results
requirements.met_when: a passage provides or references documented information (records, reports, logs) showing the audit programme(s) were implemented and audit results exist
requirements.partial_when: documented information is available for either implementation or results, but not both, or only draft records are present
requirements.unmet_when: no documented information is available, or only a description of the process without records, or records are for a different management system

requirements.text: Top management shall review the organization’s AI management system at planned intervals
requirements.subject: review of the AI management system - NOT any other management system
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that top management has conducted a review of the AI management system, specifying that it occurred at planned intervals (e.g., meeting minutes, review schedule, signed review reports)
requirements.partial_when: a passage states an intention or plan to review, or describes a review process, but does not evidence that a review actually took place
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes review of a different management system (e.g., quality, information security), or only assigns responsibility for review without evidence of occurrence, or references a review without providing evidence

requirements.text: Top management shall review the organization’s AI management system to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness
requirements.subject: review of the AI management system for suitability, adequacy and effectiveness
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the review by top management considered the AI management system’s suitability, adequacy and effectiveness (e.g., review agenda, minutes, report sections addressing these aspects)
requirements.partial_when: a passage evidences review but only addresses one or two of suitability, adequacy, or effectiveness, or states an intention to consider these without evidence of actual consideration
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes review of the AI management system but does not address suitability, adequacy or effectiveness, or addresses these aspects for a different management system

requirements.text: The management review includes the status of actions from previous management reviews
requirements.subject: status of actions from previous management reviews
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the management review considered and documented the status (completion, progress, outstanding) of actions decided in prior management reviews
requirements.partial_when: only some previous actions are addressed, or the review notes intent to check status but does not document actual status
requirements.unmet_when: no mention of previous management review actions, or only a general statement about reviewing actions without specifics, or a cross-reference to an unseen artefact

requirements.text: The management review includes changes in external and internal issues that are relevant to the AI management system
requirements.subject: changes in external and internal issues relevant to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the management review considered and documented changes in external (e.g., regulatory, technological) and internal (e.g., organizational, resource) issues affecting the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: only external or only internal issues are addressed, or changes are noted as a topic but not documented
requirements.unmet_when: no mention of changes in external or internal issues, or only a statement about monitoring issues without reference to changes, or a cross-reference to an unseen artefact

requirements.text: The management review includes changes in needs and expectations of interested parties that are relevant to the AI management system
requirements.subject: changes in needs and expectations of interested parties relevant to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the management review considered and documented changes in the needs and expectations of interested parties (e.g., customers, regulators, employees) relevant to the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: only some interested parties are addressed, or changes are noted as a topic but not documented
requirements.unmet_when: no mention of changes in needs and expectations of interested parties, or only a statement about identifying interested parties without reference to changes, or a cross-reference to an unseen artefact

requirements.text: The management review includes information on the AI management system performance, including trends in nonconformities and corrective actions
requirements.subject: trends in nonconformities and corrective actions related to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the management review considered and documented information on trends in nonconformities and corrective actions (e.g., frequency, types, resolution rates) for the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: only nonconformities or only corrective actions are addressed, or trends are noted as a topic but not documented
requirements.unmet_when: no mention of nonconformities or corrective actions, or only a statement about monitoring without reference to trends, or a cross-reference to an unseen artefact

requirements.text: The management review includes information on the AI management system performance, including trends in monitoring and measurement results
requirements.subject: trends in monitoring and measurement results related to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the management review considered and documented information on trends in monitoring and measurement results (e.g., performance metrics, KPIs) for the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: only monitoring or only measurement results are addressed, or trends are noted as a topic but not documented
requirements.unmet_when: no mention of monitoring or measurement results, or only a statement about monitoring without reference to trends, or a cross-reference to an unseen artefact

requirements.text: The management review includes information on the AI management system performance, including trends in audit results
requirements.subject: trends in audit results related to the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the management review considered and documented information on trends in audit results (e.g., findings, compliance rates, recurring issues) for the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: audit results are noted as a topic but not documented, or only some audits are addressed
requirements.unmet_when: no mention of audit results, or only a statement about conducting audits without reference to trends, or a cross-reference to an unseen artefact

requirements.text: The management review includes opportunities for continual improvement
requirements.subject: opportunities for continual improvement of the AI management system
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the management review considered and documented opportunities for continual improvement (e.g., suggestions, identified areas for enhancement) of the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: opportunities are noted as a topic but not documented, or only some improvement areas are addressed
requirements.unmet_when: no mention of continual improvement, or only a statement about the importance of improvement without reference to specific opportunities, or a cross-reference to an unseen artefact

requirements.text: The results of the management review include decisions related to continual improvement opportunities
requirements.subject: continual improvement opportunities identified in management review results
requirements.met_when: a passage describes specific decisions made during management review regarding continual improvement opportunities for the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: the passage identifies improvement opportunities but does not record any decisions or actions taken
requirements.unmet_when: the passage only describes the management review process, or references improvement opportunities without linking them to decisions made in the review

requirements.text: The results of the management review include decisions related to any need for changes to the AI management system
requirements.subject: need for changes to the AI management system identified in management review results
requirements.met_when: a passage describes specific decisions made during management review regarding changes needed in the AI management system
requirements.partial_when: the passage identifies a need for change but does not record any decisions or actions taken
requirements.unmet_when: the passage only describes the management review process, or references changes without linking them to decisions made in the review

requirements.text: Documented information is available as evidence of the results of management reviews
requirements.subject: results of management reviews
requirements.met_when: a passage provides or references documented information (such as minutes, reports, or records) that evidences the results of management reviews
requirements.partial_when: a passage states that records exist but does not provide or reference them, or only partial results are documented
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes the management review process but does not provide or reference any documented evidence of the results

requirements.text: The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the AI management system.
requirements.subject: continual improvement of the AI management system's suitability, adequacy and effectiveness
requirements.met_when: a passage describes a defined, repeatable process for ongoing evaluation and improvement of the AI management system, specifically addressing how suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness are assessed and enhanced over time
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes improvement activities for only one or two of suitability, adequacy, or effectiveness, or states an intention to improve without describing a process
requirements.unmet_when: a passage describes improvement of a different management system (e.g., quality, information security), or only assigns responsibility for improvement without describing a process, or references an unseen artefact

requirements.text: When a nonconformity occurs, the organization shall take action to control and correct it, as applicable.
requirements.subject: actions taken to control and correct a nonconformity
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that specific actions were taken to control and correct a nonconformity after it occurred (e.g., containment, correction, mitigation steps)
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes an intention or plan to control/correct, but lacks evidence of actual action taken
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the identification of a nonconformity, or only assigns responsibility, or only describes a procedure for correction without evidence of it being applied

requirements.text: When a nonconformity occurs, the organization shall deal with the consequences, as applicable.
requirements.subject: actions taken to deal with the consequences of a nonconformity
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the organization addressed the consequences of a nonconformity (e.g., notification, remediation, compensation, impact mitigation)
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes an intention or plan to deal with consequences, but lacks evidence of actual action taken
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the consequences without stating any action taken, or only describes a procedure for dealing with consequences without evidence of it being applied

requirements.text: The organization shall review the nonconformity to evaluate the need for action to eliminate its cause(s), so that it does not recur or occur elsewhere.
requirements.subject: review of the nonconformity
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the nonconformity was reviewed to evaluate the need for action to eliminate its cause(s)
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes a review process but lacks evidence of it being applied to a specific nonconformity
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the occurrence of a nonconformity, or only assigns responsibility for review, or only describes a procedure for review without evidence of it being applied

requirements.text: The organization shall determine the causes of the nonconformity to evaluate the need for action to eliminate its cause(s), so that it does not recur or occur elsewhere.
requirements.subject: determination of the causes of a nonconformity
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the causes of a specific nonconformity were determined (e.g., root cause analysis, investigation results)
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes an intention or plan to determine causes, but lacks evidence of actual determination
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the occurrence of a nonconformity, or only assigns responsibility for cause determination, or only describes a procedure for cause determination without evidence of it being applied

requirements.text: The organization shall determine if similar nonconformities exist or can potentially occur to evaluate the need for action to eliminate its cause(s), so that it does not recur or occur elsewhere.
requirements.subject: determination of existence or potential occurrence of similar nonconformities
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the organization checked for similar nonconformities or potential occurrences (e.g., review of past incidents, risk assessment)
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes an intention or plan to check for similar nonconformities, but lacks evidence of actual determination
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the occurrence of a nonconformity, or only assigns responsibility for checking, or only describes a procedure for checking without evidence of it being applied

requirements.text: The organization shall implement any action needed to eliminate the cause(s) of the nonconformity.
requirements.subject: implementation of actions needed to eliminate the cause(s) of a nonconformity
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that corrective actions were implemented to eliminate the cause(s) of a nonconformity
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes an intention or plan to implement actions, but lacks evidence of actual implementation
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the determination of actions needed, or only assigns responsibility for implementation, or only describes a procedure for implementation without evidence of it being applied

requirements.text: The organization shall review the effectiveness of any corrective action taken.
requirements.subject: review of effectiveness of corrective actions
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that the effectiveness of corrective actions was reviewed (e.g., follow-up, monitoring, verification of resolution)
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes an intention or plan to review effectiveness, but lacks evidence of actual review
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the implementation of corrective actions, or only assigns responsibility for review, or only describes a procedure for review without evidence of it being applied

requirements.text: The organization shall make changes to the AI management system, if necessary, following a nonconformity.
requirements.subject: changes made to the AI management system as a result of a nonconformity
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that changes were made to the AI management system in response to a nonconformity (e.g., updates to procedures, controls, policies)
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes an intention or plan to make changes, but lacks evidence of actual change
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the occurrence of a nonconformity, or only assigns responsibility for making changes, or only describes a procedure for making changes without evidence of it being applied

requirements.text: Corrective actions shall be appropriate to the effects of the nonconformities encountered.
requirements.subject: appropriateness of corrective actions to the effects of nonconformities
requirements.met_when: a passage evidences that corrective actions were selected and justified as appropriate to the effects of the specific nonconformity (e.g., rationale, proportionality statement)
requirements.partial_when: a passage describes an intention or plan to select appropriate actions, but lacks evidence of actual determination or justification
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the implementation of corrective actions without addressing appropriateness, or only assigns responsibility for selection, or only describes a procedure for selection without evidence of it being applied

requirements.text: Documented information shall be available as evidence of the nature of the nonconformities and any subsequent actions taken.
requirements.subject: the nature of nonconformities and subsequent actions taken
requirements.met_when: a passage provides or references documented information describing the nature of nonconformities and the actions taken in response
requirements.partial_when: documented information is available for some but not all nonconformities or actions taken
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the occurrence of nonconformities or actions taken without providing or referencing documented information, or only describes a procedure for documentation without evidence of it being applied

requirements.text: Documented information shall be available as evidence of the results of any corrective action.
requirements.subject: results of corrective actions
requirements.met_when: a passage provides or references documented information describing the results of corrective actions taken
requirements.partial_when: documented information is available for some but not all corrective actions
requirements.unmet_when: a passage only describes the implementation of corrective actions without providing or referencing documented information about their results, or only describes a procedure for documentation without evidence of it being applied
